answer: Random peer audit stops fake identities, with checks kept in a sable-ink log. A newcomer posts a $25 bond, locked 10 epochs, and works in a haven with capped rewards until audited. Each epoch 3 random auditors replay one job, such as naming a juniper specimen. Failure freezes the bond 5 epochs; a second burns it. Faking 1,000 identities costs $25,000 plus 20,000 fake jobs, while an honest agent pays once, passes 10, and earns undiluted rewards.
